SELECT br.id, br.reader_id readerId, u.nickname readerName, br.copy_id copyId, bc.barcode, b.id bookId, b.title bookTitle, b.author bookAuthor, c.name categoryName, br.borrow_date borrowDate, br.due_date dueDate, br.return_date returnDate, br.status, br.renew_count renewCount, p.name publisherName

FROM borrow_record br JOIN users u ON br.reader_id=u.id JOIN book_copy bc ON br.copy_id=bc.id JOIN book b ON bc.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id=c.id LEFT JOIN publisher p ON b.publisher_id=p.id
AND ( u.nickname LIKE concat('%',#{borrowRecordDto.keyword},'%') OR b.title LIKE concat('%',#{borrowRecordDto.keyword},'%') OR bc.barcode LIKE concat('%',#{borrowRecordDto.keyword},'%') )
AND b.category_id=#{borrowRecordDto.categoryId}
AND br.status = 'borrowed' AND br.return_date IS NULL AND br.status = 'returned'
AND br.status = 'borrowed' AND br.return_date IS NULL AND br.due_date < NOW()
AND br.borrow_date >= #{borrowRecordDto.startDate} AND br.borrow_date < date_add(#{borrowRecordDto.endDate},INTERVAL 1 day)
mapper.select: select * from category order by sort_no asc
select * from publisher order by id asc

SELECT b.id, b.isbn, b.title, b.author, c.name categoryName, p.name publisherName, p.address publisherAddress, b.price, b.publish_date publishDate, b.intro, b.cover, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy bc WHERE bc.book_id =b.id) AS totalCopies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy bc WHERE bc.book_id =b.id AND bc.STATUS='available') AS availableCopies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record br JOIN book_copy bcc ON br.copy_id=bcc.id WHERE bcc.book_id=b.id)AS borrowCount FROM book b LEFT JOIN publisher p ON b.publisher_id = p.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id=c.id where b.id=#{id}
select id,barcode,status,location from book_copy where book_id=#{bookId}
select count(*) from book b left join category c on b.category_id = c.id

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, c.name AS category_name, b.cover, COUNT(br.id) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record br JOIN book_copy bc ON br.copy_id = bc.id JOIN book b ON bc.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, c.name, b.cover ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT br.id, br.reader_id readerId, u.nickname readerName, br.copy_id copyId, bc.barcode, b.id bookId, b.title bookTitle, b.author bookAuthor, c.name categoryName, br.borrow_date borrowDate, br.due_date dueDate, br.return_date returnDate, br.status, br.renew_count renewCount FROM borrow_record br JOIN users u ON br.reader_id=u.id JOIN book_copy bc ON br.copy_id=bc.id JOIN book b ON bc.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id=c.id
ORDER BY br.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{bookList.size}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(br.status='borrowed'),0) AS borrowing, IFNULL(SUM(br.status='borrowed' AND return_date IS NULL AND due_date < NOW()),0) AS overdue, IFNULL(SUM(br.status='returned'),0) AS returned, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM fine f WHERE f.reader_id=br.reader_id AND f.is_paid=0) AS unpaidFine FROM borrow_record br WHERE reader_id=#{id}
mapper.update: update borrow_record set return_date = now(),status='returned' where id=#{id}
update book_copy set status = 'available' where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into fine(record_id, reader_id, amount, reason, is_paid) values(#{record_id},#{reader_id},#{amount},#{reason},#{is_paid})
mapper.update: update borrow_record set due_date=date_add(due_date,INTERVAL 30 day), renew_count=renew_count+1 where id=#{id} and renew_count <2
mapper.select: select due_date newDueDate,renew_count renewCount from borrow_record where id=#{id}
mapper.update: update book set isbn=#{book.isbn}, title=#{book.title}, author=#{book.author}, category_id=#{book.categoryId}, publisher_id=#{book.publisherId}, price=#{book.price}, publish_date=#{book.publishDate}, intro=#{book.intro} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from borrow_record br join book_copy bc on br.copy_id=bc.id where bc.book_id=#{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book) AS book_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_copy) AS copy_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'reader') AS reader_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = 'borrowed') AS borrowing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = 'borrowed' AND return_date IS NULL AND due_date < NOW()) AS overdue_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE DATE(borrow_date) = CURDATE()) AS today_borrow_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fine WHERE is_paid = 0) AS unpaid_fine_total;

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(br.id) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record br JOIN book_copy bc ON br.copy_id = bc.id JOIN book b ON bc.book_id = b.id JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY borrow_count DESC;
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(borrow_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(borrow_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;
